title: This Smoothie Is Changing People's Lives
text: This is the medical medium heavy metal detox smoothie right here at Arowan. But the HMDS has made it into the store's fresh pressed juice section. Easy to grab each day. What's incredible about it is just the story behind this heavy metal detox after all these years. All the people it has helped, all the lives it has changed. I think the heavy metal detox is just a key part of my healing journey. I do the heavy metal detox every single day. It's my breakfast. I need it. I enjoy having it every day. It's just energizing. Oh, I feel invincible. I was skeptical at first, but um I started in with the heavy metal morning cleanse and boy, right away I noticed improvement in my digestion. I just felt like I had more energy. My digestive system improved. For me, especially for my anxiety, it has been a godsend. It's funny cuz I actually resisted the heavy metal detox smoothie for a while because I was like, who puts seaweed and cilantro in a smoothie? And then finally one day I was like, "Okay, it's time." And I did it and it was so delicious that I did it every day for months and I was like, "This is amazing. Why did I ever resist it?" Your brain starts to breathe again and you you come out of that little bubble. I've noticed many improvements. It's how to pinpoint them. It boils down to just general life improvements in every regard as well as spiritually, not just for the body. I feel really invincible. I feel empowered. I'm a tool by which I can help other people. It's just all in one little container and I can just sip it or chug it or whatever I'm in the mood for. I will literally tell anybody who will listen. I'm so excited and honored. I can't even believe it. I'm holding this bottle in my hand right now. This is the Medical Medium HMDS right here. So, you can come on into any of their stores. It's on the shelf. Incredible, you guys. Incredible.
